data.text: Review (code-reviewer agent) found 5 defects, all fixed with tests: 0.5.0 compact deletes doc.* events (now: a month with unreadable events is left whole; release notes must tell teams to update before compacting); bare doc edit on a conflict picked a winner (now conflicting_state); cac turned --body 007 into 7 and crashed on --task 1 (now read raw from argv); two text sources won silently (now refused); doc link returned a partial document (now the full shape, pinned in schema-contract).
